---
title: "Appendix A - Abrolhos to Eastern Recherche Natural Values Report"
subtitle: "South-west Marine Parks Network"
filters:
  - figure-numbering.lua
format:
  pdf:
    output-file: "Project 4.21-sw-coast-2-Appendix A-q-Natural values.pdf"
    fig-pos: 'H'
    geometry: 
      - top=2cm
      - bottom=2.5cm
      - left=2cm
      - right=2cm
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{caption}
        \usepackage{float}
        \usepackage{chngcntr}
        \usepackage{array}
        \floatplacement{table}{H}
        \newcounter{metric}
        \counterwithin*{figure}{metric}
        \captionsetup{format=plain, indention=0pt}
        % Appendix prefix. Change A1 here and in figure-numbering.lua together.
        \renewcommand{\thefigure}{A1.\arabic{figure}}
        \renewcommand{\thetable}{A1.\arabic{table}}
  html:
    output-file: "Project 4.21-sw-coast-2-Appendix A-q-Natural values.html"
    fig-dpi: 96
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
          caption,
          .gt_caption,
          .table-caption,
          figcaption,
          .figure-caption,
          .quarto-float-caption,
          .quarto-float-caption-top,
          .quarto-float-tbl figcaption {
            text-align: justify !important;
            text-justify: inter-word;
            hyphens: auto;
          }
        </style>
    include-after-body:
      text: |
        <script>
        // Figures are prefixed by figure-numbering.lua. Quarto builds the table
        // caption after that filter runs, so the table prefix is applied here.
        // TODO Keep "A1" in step with fig_prefix in figure-numbering.lua.
        document.querySelectorAll("caption, .gt_caption, .table-caption, figcaption")
          .forEach(function (el) {
            // el.innerHTML re-serialises a non-breaking space as the literal
            // "&nbsp;" entity text, not a whitespace character, so \s alone
            // does not match it - match either form here.
            el.innerHTML = el.innerHTML.replace(/^(\s*Table(?:\s|&nbsp;)+)(\d+)/, "$1A1.$2");
          });
        </script>
toc: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
post-render: 10_move-pdf.R
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)
library(cowplot)
library(png)
library(grid)
library(tidytext)
library(ggtext)
library(dplyr)
library(gt)

# Park folder and file prefix - must match 00_config.yml.
park <- "sw-coast"
name <- "sw-coast"
```

# Natural Values

Understanding of natural values

{{< pagebreak >}}

## Sampling summary

```{=latex}
\setlength{\extrarowheight}{4pt}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sampling-effort
#| tbl-cap: "Summary of monitoring campaigns in the study area, showing the survey dates, sampling method, management zones sampled, and the number of samples with each data type. NPZ = National Park Zone, HPZ = Habitat Protection Zone, MUZ = Multiple Use Zone, SPZ = Special Purpose Zone."

# LaTeX will not break a line at an underscore, so a long campaign ID would run
# past its column. Swapping underscores for spaces lets the name wrap.
sampling_summary <- readRDS(here("data", park, "tidy",
                                 paste0(name, "_sampling-summary.RDS"))) %>%
  mutate(campaignid = gsub("_", " ", campaignid))

col_labels <- c("Date", "Campaign name", "Method", "Areas", "Samples",
                "Count", "Count", "Length")

sampling_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(dates         = col_labels[1],
             campaignid    = col_labels[2],
             method        = col_labels[3],
             areas         = col_labels[4],
             n_samples     = col_labels[5],
             habitat_count = col_labels[6],
             fish_count    = col_labels[7],
             fish_length   = col_labels[8]) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Habitat", columns = habitat_count) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Fish",    columns = c(fish_count, fish_length)) %>%
  sub_zero(zero_text = "-") %>%
  cols_width(dates         ~ pct(14),
             campaignid    ~ pct(20),
             method        ~ pct(11),
             areas         ~ pct(15),
             n_samples     ~ pct(10),
             habitat_count ~ pct(10),
             fish_count    ~ pct(10),
             fish_length   ~ pct(10)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left",
             columns = c(dates, campaignid, areas)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center",
             columns = c(method, n_samples, habitat_count, fish_count,
                         fish_length)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "grey90"), # Grey every second row
            locations = cells_body(rows = seq(2, nrow(sampling_summary), by = 2))) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = list(cells_column_labels(),
                             cells_column_spanners(spanners = everything()))) %>%
  tab_options(table.width               = pct(100),
              table.font.size           = px(11),
              data_row.padding          = px(4),
              latex.use_longtable       = TRUE,
              column_labels.border.top.style = "none",
              table.border.top.style    = "none",
              table_body.hlines.style   = "none")
```

```{=latex}
\setlength{\extrarowheight}{0pt}
```

## Benthic ecosystem extent


## Threatened species

```{=latex}
\stepcounter{metric}
```

```{=latex}
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.4}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-threatened-species
#| tbl-cap: "Threatened species recorded in stereo-BRUV imagery across all survey years, showing IUCN Red List category, the number of samples each species was recorded in, and the total abundance (MaxN) summed across those samples. *This species is also listed as ‘Conservation dependent’ on the EPBC Act List of Threatened Fauna. ^This species is also listed as ‘Vulnerable’ on the EPBC Act List of Threatened Fauna."

threatened_species <- readRDS(here("data", park, "tidy",
                                   paste0(name, "_threatened-species.RDS")))

threatened_species %>%
  dplyr::select(species_label, australian_common_name, family, listing,
                n_samples, total_maxn) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(species_label           = "Species",
             australian_common_name = "Common name",
             family                 = "Family",
             listing                = "IUCN category",
             n_samples              = "Samples",
             total_maxn             = "Total MaxN") %>%
  sub_missing(missing_text = "-") %>%
  cols_width(species_label           ~ pct(22.8),
             australian_common_name ~ pct(20.8),
             family                 ~ pct(17.8),
             listing                ~ pct(15.8),
             n_samples              ~ pct(10.9),
             total_maxn             ~ pct(11.9)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left",
             columns = c(species_label, australian_common_name, family)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center",
             columns = c(listing, n_samples, total_maxn)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(style = "italic"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = species_label)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "grey90"), # Grey every second row
            locations = cells_body(rows = seq(2, nrow(threatened_species), by = 2))) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels()) %>%
  tab_options(table.width               = pct(100),
              table.font.size           = px(11),
              data_row.padding          = px(6),
              latex.use_longtable       = TRUE,
              column_labels.border.top.style = "none",
              table.border.top.style    = "none",
              table_body.hlines.style   = "none")
```

```{=latex}
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1}
```
